title: Evaluation characterization of the ordinary finite coefficient Hom transpose
statement: For the finite coefficient quotient and arbitrary objects K and M, the ordinary evaluation comparison satisfies the reduced evaluation equation in the normalized closed structures: its tensor with the reduced K, followed by the reduced closed evaluation, equals the inverse scalar tensorator followed by scalar extension of the original closed evaluation.

source.place: Opening sentence and proof paragraphs 1--2: identify the ordinary transpose by tensoring evaluation and applying the scalar tensor comparison.

proof.text: Expand the ordinary evaluation comparison as the left-tensor adjoint of the ordinary tensor comparison followed by scalar extension of evaluation. Identify the normalized closed tensor and evaluation with the published ordinary derived tensor and counit, then transport across the signed braiding and cancel the inverse tensorator. The resulting composite is exactly the reduced evaluation equation.

mathlib_searches.query: The internal Hom comparison for a symmetric strong monoidal functor is the transpose of evaluation, independently of using left tensor or right tensor adjunction
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits: CategoryTheory.expComparison and seven related Cartesian closed functor lemmas in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Closed/Functor. These require Cartesian monoidal structures and do not identify the published derived tensor comparison or either of our closed records.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteHom_ordinary_transpose_evaluation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u}) {n m : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (K M : finiteHomEtale l E X n) :
    (finiteHomEtaleClosed l E X m).tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (Etale.CoefficientPairingChange.evaluationComparison
            (finiteHomQuotient l E h) X K M)
            (𝟙 ((finiteHomEtaleReduction l E X h).obj K))) ≫
        (finiteHomEtaleClosed l E X m).evaluation ((finiteHomEtaleReduction l E X h).obj K)
          ((finiteHomEtaleReduction l E X h).obj M) =
      (finiteHomEtaleTensor l E X h).inv.app
          ((finiteHomEtaleInternalHom l E X n).obj (Opposite.op K, M), K) ≫
        (finiteHomEtaleReduction l E X h).map ((finiteHomEtaleClosed l E X n).evaluation K M)
